title: You lay down, blink, and when you open your eyes you begin levitating over your bed, slowly drifting toward and then out of the window...
content: My 8 year old daughter had a dream that begins like this, but she is not sure it was a dream as it seemed very real. No mall here, but she feels like she ends up in a space where she is sure that she is sharing a dream/ some experience with other kids who are equally unsure of what is happening. I understand this is a rather common way that good and bad dreams can begin, and I believe she was dreaming as I don't think people fly undernormal circumstances, etcetera... but I was listening to a podcast (Otherworld episode 3/ Hatman) where a series of dreams that transpire similarly were interwoven with weirder things. In her recollection she is guided in flight out of the window to a shabby wooden cottage on a sort of road situated 20-30 meters off of the ground. She enters the cabin through the window and there finds 4-5 other floating children speaking a number of different languages, all of whom are confused about what they are doing there. They are all levitating above the floor, exchanging words and information sort of telepathically I guess. After a short while she flies back home, a short distance away, and into bed, and she remembers my wife walking into the room and checking on her moments later, which did happen. She does not remember waking up to note my wife's checking in on her. For her there was no going to sleep or waking up during any of this. She has lots of dreams but this sort of realism and atmosphere is totally new and she was unsure about whether she had dreamt it or not. Has anyone else had dreams like this? Going from being awake to what seems like near reality in a dream, and then back to being awake again almost seamlessly? like without ever feeling a break in consciousness? Just curious. thanks
